name: The Candle by the Window.
source:
a reflective piece about slowing down and learning from small, fleeting experiences.

connect with your plants, the moon, and the warmth from the flame of a candle.

[From [url=https://flowerpirate.itch.io/the-candle-by-the-window]Itch.io[/url]]

这是一篇关于放慢脚步并从短暂的小经历中学习的反思性文章。

与你的植物、月亮和蜡烛火焰的温暖联系起来。

[来自[url=https://flowerpirate.itch.io/the-candle-by-the-window]Itch.io[/url]]
